title.rendered: Board of Directors Meeting and Budget Committee Orientation – May 12, 2021

content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Regular Meeting and Executive Session, in addition to the Budget Committee Orientation, on Wednesday, May 12, 2021. To access a livestream video of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3

  • 5:45 pm – Budget Committee Orientation (Virtual Meeting – Live Stream)
  • 7:00pm – Regular Meeting (Virtual Meeting – Live Stream)
  • 7:30pm – Executive Session (Non-Public Meeting)

The agenda for the meeting can be found here.

To submit public comment, please use form found here. Public comment will be read during the meeting by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes per comment (as per time limit indicated on meeting agenda). Please note that identifying information is required for public comment to be read aloud during the meeting, as per Board Policy BDDH, and becomes public record once submitted.
